about.name: Nicholas Tanugroho
about.title: Data Enthusiast
introduction: I'm a passionate tech and data enthusiast, constantly driven by curiosity and the desire to grow.
Currently learning about iOS development and ecosystem at Apple Developer Academy @UC, Jakarta.  I learn how to develop a clean and impactful app within the iOS ecosystem.
I had the privilege of learning from the Bangkit Academy by Google, Traveloka, and The GOTO Group, where I pursued the Machine Learning Path.

I thrive on discovering new knowledge and taking bold steps beyond my comfort zone. Whether it's diving into cutting-edge technologies or tackling unfamiliar challenges, I'm always eager to push myself and keep evolving.

description: Developed 7 applications and prototypes using Swift and SwiftUI as part of multidisciplinary product teams.
Conducted multiple user interviews and usability tests to validate product decisions and iterate on application features.
Collaborated with teams of 5–6 members to deliver end-to-end app projects, from ideation and UI/UX design to implementation and presentation.
Presented solutions to Apple mentors and industry partners, translating user feedback into iterative product improvements.
Directed the end-to-end product development of SentakuKempo for PERKEMI DIY, digitalizing tournament operations for 32+ participants and officials.
Prioritized and defined core features including automated bracket generation, multi-role access control, and a real-time scoring system across 2 match categories.
Delivered a centralized live-monitoring dashboard utilized by 32+ committees and referees to seamlessly assess match progress and ensure event transparency.
Facilitated 3-hour laboratory sessions for classes of up to 45 students in algorithms, databases, software engineering, operations research, and IoT.
Led teams of up to 10 assistant lecturers, coordinating laboratory activities and mentoring junior assistants.
